esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during rotation.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie supine with the knees flexed and the feet supported. Keep the shoulders in contact with the surface and lower both knees slowly to one side. Return to neutral and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled circumduction of the pelvis and lumbopelvic region.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand behind a stable chair and hold the backrest. Keep both feet in contact with the floor and move the pelvis through small controlled circles. Complete 5 repetitions in each direction.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled lateral weight shift of the pelvis and lumbopelvic region.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand behind a sturdy chair and hold on with both hands. Keep your feet slightly apart. Slowly shift your weight onto your right foot without lifting the left foot from the floor. Return to the centre, then shift your weight onto your left foot. Repeat 10 times.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled circumduction of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand tall and hold a support if needed. Draw slow circles with one hip in one direction, then the other, and repeat on both sides.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on external rotation and flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Position one hip in flexion and external rotation with the knee flexed in front of the trunk, and extend the opposite lower limb posteriorly. Incline the trunk forward until a mild posterior-hip stretch is felt.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled extension and external rotation of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit in a 90/90 position. Keep the trunk tall and gently extend or lift from the back hip as far as control allows.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled internal rotation and external rotation of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit with both knees bent in a 90/90 position. Rotate the legs to switch sides slowly, using the hands for support if needed.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on external rotation and flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie supine or sit tall. Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh and gently bring the legs closer until the outer hip stretches.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the hip, with emphasis on internal rotation and external rotation.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit in a 90/90 hip position with both knees flexed. Maintain an upright trunk and apply gentle downward pressure through both lower limbs without visible movement. Hold while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled flexion, abduction, and external rotation of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand upright and use a stable support as required. Flex one hip and knee, then move the knee laterally and posteriorly through hip abduction and external rotation. Return the foot to the floor and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled abduction, adduction, and internal rotation of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand tall and hold a stable support if needed. Lift one knee out to the side, guide it forward in a circular path, then lower the foot. Repeat on the other side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.nome: Standing Hip Circumduction with Flexed Knee
esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled circumduction of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand tall on one leg and hold a stable support if needed. Lift the opposite knee to a comfortable height and draw small horizontal circles with it, first in one direction and then the other. Repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.
esercizi.imageAlt: Standing Hip Circumduction with Flexed Knee

esercizi.nome: Standing Hip Internal and External Rotation with Flexed Knee
esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled internal rotation and external rotation of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand tall and hold a stable support if needed. Bend one knee so the heel rises behind you and the knee stays near the other thigh. From this position, move the foot gently inward and outward to rotate the hip internally and externally. Repeat on the other side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.
esercizi.imageAlt: Standing Hip Internal and External Rotation with Flexed Knee

esercizi.nome: Supine Bilateral Hip Internal and External Rotation
esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled internal rotation and external rotation of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie supine with both legs straight and slightly apart. Keep the ankles dorsiflexed, then roll the legs inward and outward from the hips so the feet move like windshield wipers.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Supine Bilateral Hip Internal and External Rotation

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled pelvic elevation of the pelvis and lumbopelvic region.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright away from the backrest with both feet supported. Elevate one side of the pelvis slightly from the seat while maintaining trunk control. Hold for 2 seconds, return to neutral, and alternate sides for 10 repetitions.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during abduction.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand beside a stable support and hold it with one hand. Keeping the trunk upright and the knee extended, abduct the opposite hip by moving the leg laterally. Pause briefly, return to neutral, and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during abduction and adduction.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand behind a sturdy chair or next to a table and hold on with both hands for safety. Starting with your feet together, take a small step to the right with your right foot, then bring your left foot close to it. Repeat the same movement to the left. Move slowly and keep your body upright. Repeat 5 times on each side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during adduction and abduction.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand behind a sturdy chair and hold the backrest with both hands. Slowly cross your right foot in front of your left foot, placing it gently on the floor. Return to the starting position, then cross your left foot in front of your right foot. Alternate the movement slowly for 5 repetitions on each side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during abduction and adduction.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright on a chair with your feet resting on the floor. Slide your right foot out to the side, keeping the toes in contact with the floor, then bring it back to the centre. Repeat 5 times, then repeat with the left foot.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during abduction.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie on your side on a mat, with your lower leg slightly bent for comfort and your upper leg straight. Slowly lift the upper leg a few centimetres, keeping the toes pointing forward. Hold for 2 seconds, then lower the leg slowly. Repeat 5 times, then turn onto the other side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on abduction and flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit with both lower limbs abducted and the knees extended. Maintain axial spinal elongation and flex forward from the hips until a mild stretch is felt along the medial and posterior thighs.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.nome: Standing Cross-Body Hip Adduction and Abduction Swing
esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled abduction and adduction of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand tall and hold a support. Swing one straight leg gently across the body and then out to the side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Standing Cross-Body Hip Adduction and Abduction Swing

esercizi.nome: Standing Wide-Leg Hip Flexion Isometric Hold
esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the hip, with emphasis on abduction and flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand with the feet wide and the knees softly extended. Hinge forward at the hips while maintaining a neutral spine. Use hand support as required and hold the position while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.
esercizi.imageAlt: Standing Wide-Leg Hip Flexion Isometric Hold

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled abduction, adduction, and lateral weight shift of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand with the feet wide and hinge forward slightly at the hips. Shift the pelvis and body weight toward one side by flexing that knee, return through neutral, and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.nome: Seated Hip Abduction and External Rotation Stretch
esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on abduction and external rotation.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit with the soles of the feet together and the knees opening outward. Sit tall and let the knees lower only through the available comfortable range.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Hip Abduction and External Rotation Stretch

esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled abduction and flexion of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand with the feet wide and the knees softly extended. Flex forward from the hips while maintaining a neutral spine, then extend the hips to return to standing.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.nome: Supine Bilateral Hip Abduction and External Rotation
esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled abduction, adduction, and external rotation of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie supine with the knees flexed and the feet together. Allow both knees to move laterally into hip abduction and external rotation, then return them to neutral with control.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Supine Bilateral Hip Abduction and External Rotation

esercizi.nome: Supine Bilateral Straight-Leg Hip Abduction and Adduction
esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled abduction and adduction of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie supine with both knees extended and the ankles dorsiflexed. Slide both lower limbs laterally into hip abduction, then return them toward the midline under control.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Supine Bilateral Straight-Leg Hip Abduction and Adduction

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand facing a stable support and hold it with both hands. Keeping the trunk upright and the knee extended, move one leg posteriorly into hip extension. Hold for 3 seconds, return to neutral, and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand behind a sturdy chair and hold on with both hands. Move your right foot slightly backward and touch the floor with your toes, without shifting too much weight onto that leg. Return to the starting position and repeat 5 times. Then switch to the left leg.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled extension of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand beside a stable table or kitchen counter and keep one hand on it for support. Take one small step backward with your right foot, then bring your left foot close to it. Continue for 3 small steps, then return forward carefully. Repeat 3 times.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during extension and flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand upright and hold a stick vertically with one hand for support. Take a small step backward with your right foot, placing the toes gently on the floor. Slightly bend both knees, then push through the front leg to return to the starting position. Repeat 5 times, then switch legs.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.nome: Quadruped Hip Extension with Knee Extended
esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Assume a quadruped position on a padded surface. Slowly extend your right leg backward, sliding it along the floor first and then lifting it slightly, keeping the knee straight. Hold for 2 seconds, then return to the starting position. Repeat 5 times, then switch legs.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Quadruped Hip Extension with Knee Extended

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during flexion and extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand with the feet hip-width apart. Push the hips backward with a long spine, feel tension in the back of the thighs, then return to standing.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled flexion and extension of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand on one leg with the knee slightly soft. Hinge from the hip while the free leg reaches back, then return to standing.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during flexion and external rotation.
esercizi.howToDo: Position the lead hip in flexion and external rotation with the knee flexed and the opposite limb extended posteriorly. Maintain a neutral spine and hinge the trunk forward slightly, then return upright.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.nome: Quadruped Hip Extension with Knee Flexed
esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled extension of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Assume a quadruped position. Keeping one knee flexed to approximately 90 degrees, extend the hip by directing the plantar surface of the foot upward. Lower the limb with control and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.
esercizi.imageAlt: Quadruped Hip Extension with Knee Flexed

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright on a chair with your back well supported against the backrest. Keep your hands on the sides of the seat. Slowly lift your right foot and extend your leg forward until it is parallel to the floor. Tighten your thigh muscle well and pull your toes toward you. Hold for 3 seconds, then slowly lower your foot back down. repeat with your left leg.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie supine on a firm, comfortable surface. Bend your left knee, placing your foot on the mattress; this helps protect your back. Keep your right leg fully extended on the bed. Tighten the muscle of your right thigh and lift your straight leg only slightly, about the height of one hand. Hold the leg up for 3 seconds, then slowly lower it back down. Repeat 5 times on each side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during flexion and extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit near the front of a stable chair with both feet fully supported and slightly apart. Incline the trunk forward, extend the hips and knees, and elevate the pelvis approximately 2 to 3 cm from the seat. Hold for 2 seconds, then lower with control.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.nome: Seated Isometric Hip Flexion with Manual Resistance
esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the hip, with emphasis on flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright with both feet supported. Place both hands over the distal thigh of one side. Attempt to flex the hip while the hands provide equal downward resistance so that no visible movement occurs. Hold for 5 seconds, then repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Isometric Hip Flexion with Manual Resistance

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during flexion and extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand behind a stable chair and hold the backrest. With the feet approximately hip-width apart, flex the hips and knees through a small range, then extend them to return to standing. Repeat slowly.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.nome: Seated Alternating Hip Flexion with Contralateral Arm Raise
esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright on the front half of a chair. Lift your right knee slightly while raising your left arm forward at the same time. Lower them slowly, then lift your left knee while raising your right arm. Alternate the movement for 10 repetitions.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Alternating Hip Flexion with Contralateral Arm Raise

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand behind a sturdy chair and hold on with both hands. Move your right foot forward and lightly tap the floor with your toes. Bring the foot back to the starting position. Repeat 5 times, then switch legs.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during flexion and extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand upright and hold a stick vertically with one hand for support. Take a small step forward with your right foot. Slowly bend both knees a little, lowering your body only through the available comfortable range. Push through the front foot to return to the starting position. Repeat 5 times, then switch legs.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Assume a split-kneeling or standing lunge position. Maintain an upright trunk and translate the pelvis forward until a mild stretch is felt over the anterior aspect of the trailing hip.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the knee, with emphasis on flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Set up in a lunge and bend the back knee if comfortable. Hold the back foot with the hand or a strap and gently draw the heel toward the glute.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.nome: Wall-Supported Hip Flexor and Quadriceps Stretch
esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Place one knee near a wall or sofa with the shin supported behind you. Bring the other foot forward and lift the trunk upright as tolerated.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.
esercizi.imageAlt: Wall-Supported Hip Flexor and Quadriceps Stretch

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled flexion of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie supine with both legs straight and slightly apart. Tighten one thigh, keep the knee extended, and lift that leg upward through a comfortable range. Pause briefly, lower slowly, and repeat on the other side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand behind a stable chair and use both hands for support. Flex one knee to move the heel toward the gluteal region while maintaining an upright trunk and neutral hip position. Hold for 2 seconds, lower slowly, and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.nome: Seated Isometric Knee Flexion with Heel Contact
esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the knee, with emphasis on flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit near the front of a chair and position one heel on the floor slightly anterior to the knee. Press the heel downward and attempt to draw it posteriorly without allowing movement. Hold the isometric contraction for 5 seconds, then repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Isometric Knee Flexion with Heel Contact

esercizi.nome: Supine Isometric Knee Extension with Bolster
esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the knee, with emphasis on extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie supine with a bolster or soft ball beneath one knee. Press the posterior knee downward into the support to activate the quadriceps and extend the knee, allowing the heel to elevate slightly. Hold for 4 seconds, then repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.
esercizi.imageAlt: Supine Isometric Knee Extension with Bolster

esercizi.nome: Seated Resisted Knee Flexion Heel Slide
esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright with one foot fully supported slightly anterior to the chair. Apply moderate downward pressure through the heel and slide the foot posteriorly to flex the knee. Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Resisted Knee Flexion Heel Slide

esercizi.nome: Seated Isometric Hip Extension into Cushion
esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the hip, with emphasis on extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright on a chair. Place a small soft cushion or folded towel under your right thigh, close to the back of the knee. Press your thigh downward into the cushion for 5 seconds, then relax. Repeat 5 times, then switch legs.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Isometric Hip Extension into Cushion

esercizi.nome: Supported Alternating Hamstring Mobilization in Forward Fold
esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on flexion and extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Assume a supported forward-fold position with the hands resting on the thighs, blocks, or floor. Flex one knee while extending the opposite knee, then alternate sides in a slow continuous sequence.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.
esercizi.imageAlt: Supported Alternating Hamstring Mobilization in Forward Fold

esercizi.nome: Supported Standing Straight-Leg Hip Flexion and Extension
esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled flexion and extension of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand tall and hold a support if needed. Swing one straight leg forward and back through a comfortable range, keeping the trunk upright.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Supported Standing Straight-Leg Hip Flexion and Extension

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Place one heel in front with the knee straight or slightly soft. Hinge from the hips and reach the chest forward until the back of the thigh stretches.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled flexion and extension of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Start in a lunge stance. Shift the hips backward, straighten the front knee as tolerated, then return to the lunge with control.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand with the feet hip-width apart. Hinge forward and let the hands reach toward the toes, stopping where a comfortable stretch is felt.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.nome: Supine Active Knee Extension Hamstring Mobilization
esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the knee, with emphasis on extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie supine or sit with one thigh supported by both hands. Keeping the hip position stable, extend the knee until a mild posterior-thigh stretch is felt, then flex the knee to return.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.
esercizi.imageAlt: Supine Active Knee Extension Hamstring Mobilization

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Place one leg forward or on a low support. Keep the back flat and hinge from the hips until the back of the thigh stretches.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during flexion and extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Kneel upright on a padded surface with the hips extended. Move the pelvis posteriorly by hinging at the hips while maintaining a neutral spine, then return to the upright position.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit with one knee extended and the opposite hip and knee flexed comfortably to the side. Hinge forward from the hips toward the extended limb until a mild posterior-thigh stretch is felt.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled flexion and extension of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Assume a supported forward-fold position. Alternate gentle knee flexion and extension on both sides while maintaining controlled hip flexion and steady breathing.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit with the legs extended forward. Reach the hands toward the feet while keeping the stretch tolerable and breathe slowly.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: From a lunge position, shift the hips backward and straighten the front leg as tolerated. Hold the stretch behind the thigh.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit near the front of a chair with the back away from the backrest. Keep one knee bent to 90 degrees with the foot flat. Extend the opposite leg with the heel on the floor and the toes pointing upward. Hinge the chest forward toward the knees, then return upright and switch sides.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled flexion of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand behind a stable chair and hold the backrest. Lift one foot, advance it over a marked line or low floor target, and return it to the starting position. Repeat 5 times, then change sides.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the hip during flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Assume a quadruped position on a padded surface. Keeping your hands on the floor, slowly move your pelvis backward toward your heels, only through the available comfortable range. Then return slowly to the starting position. Repeat 5 times.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled flexion of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand beside a low step or imaginary line and hold a support if needed. Lift one leg, pass it over the step, then bring it back with control.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during flexion and extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand with the feet about hip-width apart. Bend the knees and hips to lower into a comfortable squat, then stand tall again.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the hip, with emphasis on extension and flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Step into a lunge stance. Lower gently until the front of the back hip stretches, then make small controlled pulses.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during flexion and extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand in a split stance. Flex both hips and knees to lower vertically through the available controlled range, then extend the lower limbs to return to standing.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled abduction and adduction of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand with the feet wide. Shift the body weight laterally while flexing one hip and knee and keeping the opposite knee extended. Return through the centre and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the hip, with emphasis on flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand close to a stable support. Flex the hips and knees to descend into a deep squat through the available range. Hold the position with steady breathing and use upper-limb support as required.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled flexion, abduction, and extension of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand steadily on one leg with a stable support nearby. With the toes of the free foot, tap the floor in front, return to centre, tap to the side, return, then tap behind and return. Switch legs after completing the sequence.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled flexion, abduction, and extension of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand steadily on one leg with a stable support nearby. Keep the other foot lightly touching the floor and slide it forward, back to centre, to the side, back to centre, and behind before returning. Repeat on the opposite leg.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled flexion, abduction, and extension of the hip.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand on one lower limb with a stable support available. Lift the opposite foot clear of the floor and place it lightly in front, laterally, and posteriorly, returning to centre after each direction. Repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.

esercizi.nome: Supine Heel Slide for Knee Flexion and Extension
esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during flexion and extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie supine on a firm, comfortable surface with your legs extended. Slowly slide your right heel along the mattress, bringing it toward your gluteal region so that you bend your knee through the available comfortable range. Then slide your heel forward to return to the starting position. Repeat 5 times for each leg.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Supine Heel Slide for Knee Flexion and Extension

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Lie prone on a firm, comfortable surface. Flex one knee to move the heel toward the gluteal region through the available comfortable range. Hold for 3 seconds, lower slowly, and repeat on the opposite side. Place a low cushion beneath the abdomen if required for comfort.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.nome: Seated Pendular Knee Flexion and Extension
esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during flexion and extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit on a sufficiently high chair so that the lower legs can move freely. Allow one knee to flex and extend through a small pendular range for 10 seconds, then repeat with the opposite leg.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Pendular Knee Flexion and Extension

esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled circumduction of the knee.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright on a chair with your feet resting on the floor. Lift your right foot slightly from the ground and draw small circles in the air with your knee. Make 5 slow circles in one direction, then 5 in the opposite direction. Place the foot down and repeat with the left leg.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the knee, with emphasis on extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit on the bed or on a comfortable sofa with your legs stretched out in front of you. Place a rolled towel or a small cushion under your right thigh, just above the knee. Push the back of your thigh downward against the cushion and, at the same time, straighten your knee by lifting your heel off the bed. Keep your leg straight for 4 seconds, then slowly lower it back down.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.nome: Seated Active Knee Extension with Heel Support
esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the knee during extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright on a chair. Place your right heel on the floor slightly in front of you, with your toes pointing upward. Slowly straighten your knee as much as comfortable, gently tightening the front of your thigh. Hold for 3 seconds, then relax. Repeat 5 times and switch legs.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Active Knee Extension with Heel Support

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the ankle during plantar flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand behind the backrest of a sturdy chair, or in front of a table, and place both hands on it for safety. Keeping your body straight, slowly lift your heels off the floor, rising up onto your toes. Stay up for 2 seconds, then slowly lower yourself back down, placing the whole sole of your foot on the floor. Repeat 10 times.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This mobility exercise provides a controlled stretch to the ankle, with emphasis on dorsiflexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand facing a wall and place both hands on it at chest height. Step your right foot slightly backward, keeping the heel on the floor and the knee straight. Bend the front knee a little until you feel a gentle stretch in the back calf. Hold for 5 seconds, then switch legs.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain stable alignment and progress gradually to a mild, tolerable stretch while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not bounce, force end range, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the ankle, with emphasis on plantar flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright with both feet supported. Press the forefoot of one side into the floor to generate plantar-flexor tension without lifting the heel. Hold for 5 seconds, relax, and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the ankle during dorsiflexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright with both feet supported. Keep both heels in contact with the floor and dorsiflex the ankles to elevate the forefeet. Hold for 3 seconds, then lower slowly. Repeat for 10 repetitions.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.nome: Seated Ankle Plantar Flexion and Dorsiflexion
esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the ankle during plantar flexion and dorsiflexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright and lift one foot slightly from the floor. Move the ankle into plantar flexion and then dorsiflexion through the available comfortable range. Repeat for 10 cycles, then change sides.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Ankle Plantar Flexion and Dorsiflexion

esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the ankle, with emphasis on eversion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright with the lateral borders of both feet against the inner surfaces of stable chair legs. Apply outward pressure through the feet without allowing movement. Hold for 5 seconds, then relax.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.nome: Seated Multidirectional Ankle Range of Motion
esercizi.description: This active mobility exercise is intended to improve controlled circumduction of the ankle.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright and elevate one foot slightly from the floor. Move the ankle through multiple directions to trace the numbers 1 to 5 with the great toe. Lower the foot and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Multidirectional Ankle Range of Motion

esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the ankle, with emphasis on inversion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit near the front of a chair with the knees slightly apart and the medial borders of the feet in contact. Press the feet together without visible movement. Hold for 5 seconds, then relax.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the ankle during eversion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright with both feet supported. Keep one heel in contact with the floor and evert the ankle by elevating the lateral border of the foot. Hold for 3 seconds, lower slowly, and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.nome: Seated Ankle Plantar Flexion and Dorsiflexion Rock
esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the ankle during plantar flexion and dorsiflexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit on the front part of a chair, with your back away from the backrest. Slowly lift your heels, rising onto your toes. Slowly lower them back down and, without stopping, lift your toes, shifting onto your heels. Continue this slow, controlled rocking movement 5 times.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Ankle Plantar Flexion and Dorsiflexion Rock

esercizi.nome: Supported Standing Anterior and Posterior Weight Shift
esercizi.description: This exercise challenges postural control and lower-limb stability during controlled plantar flexion and dorsiflexion of the ankle.
esercizi.howToDo: Stand behind a sturdy chair and hold on with both hands. Slowly shift your body weight forward onto your toes, lifting your heels slightly from the floor. Then slowly shift your weight backward onto your heels, lifting the front part of your feet slightly. Continue this gentle rocking movement for 5 repetitions.
esercizi.whatToDo: Use a stable support when required. Maintain neutral lower-limb alignment and perform each movement slowly under control.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not continue without stable support if balance is uncertain. Avoid rapid weight shifts or loss of lower-limb alignment.
esercizi.imageAlt: Supported Standing Anterior and Posterior Weight Shift

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the ankle during inversion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright with both feet supported. Keep one heel in contact with the floor and invert the ankle by elevating the medial border of the foot. Hold for 2 seconds, lower slowly, and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral alignment and perform each phase slowly through the available comfortable range while breathing normally.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the foot and toes during toe flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright on a chair. Spread a cloth handkerchief, or a piece of kitchen paper, on the floor in front of your right foot. Place your bare foot, or your foot with a sock on, over the handkerchief. Using only your toes, scrunch and pull the cloth toward your heel. Repeat 3 times, then switch feet.
esercizi.whatToDo: Stabilize the proximal segment, isolate the intended movement, and perform each repetition slowly with minimal compensatory motion.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the foot and toes during toe abduction.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright with both feet supported. Keep the metatarsal heads in contact with the floor and abduct the toes of one foot. Hold for 3 seconds, relax, and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Stabilize the proximal segment, isolate the intended movement, and perform each repetition slowly with minimal compensatory motion.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.nome: Seated Plantar Soft-Tissue Mobilization with Ball
esercizi.description: This self-mobilization exercise applies controlled pressure to the foot and toes to support local soft-tissue mobility and sensory awareness.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright. Place a tennis ball, or a hard rubber ball, under the sole of your right foot. Slide your foot forward and backward over the ball, applying gentle pressure, from the heel to the toes. Continue this slow massage for 15 seconds, then switch to the left foot.
esercizi.whatToDo: Apply light to moderate pressure and move slowly over the plantar soft tissues while keeping the foot and ankle relaxed.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not apply pressure over bony prominences or continue if numbness, tingling, or sharp pain occurs.
esercizi.imageAlt: Seated Plantar Soft-Tissue Mobilization with Ball

esercizi.description: This exercise is intended to improve active range of motion and movement control of the foot and toes during toe extension.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright with both feet supported. Elevate the great toe of one foot while keeping the lesser toes in contact with the floor. Reverse the pattern by pressing the great toe down and elevating the lesser toes. Alternate slowly, then repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Stabilize the proximal segment, isolate the intended movement, and perform each repetition slowly with minimal compensatory motion.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not use momentum, force end range, or continue if the exercise produces sharp or progressively increasing pain.

esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the foot and toes, with emphasis on toe flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit upright with both feet supported. Press the toes of one foot gently into the floor while minimizing excessive toe curling. Hold for 5 seconds, relax, and repeat on the opposite side.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.

esercizi.description: This exercise uses a submaximal isometric contraction to develop neuromuscular control of the foot and toes, with emphasis on toe flexion.
esercizi.howToDo: Sit with your feet flat on the floor. Keep the right foot still and press only the big toe downward into the floor. Hold the pressure for 3 seconds, then relax. Repeat 5 times, then switch feet.
esercizi.whatToDo: Maintain neutral joint alignment, apply a steady submaximal contraction, and continue breathing throughout the hold.
esercizi.whatNotToDo: Do not hold the breath, apply maximal force, or continue if sharp or progressively increasing pain occurs.
